title: Better stasis chambers
description: Better Stasis locks any pressure plate pressed when you cast a fishing rod onto it — survives death, disconnect, and restart, works across dimensions, and supports as many independent rods as you want.
body:
Better Stasis
A smarter take on the vanilla fishing-rod stasis trick. Cast a rod onto a pressure plate — it locks pressed via an invisible armor stand. Cast the same rod again to release it.

Why it's better:

Survives death, disconnect, and server restart
Works across dimensions with auto chunk-loading
Per-rod tracking — every rod controls its own plate, carry as many as you want
Pure server-side, no client mods or resource packs needed
Supports all wooden, stone, and polished blackstone plates. Paper 1.21.x. Drop the JAR in plugins/ and you're done.
